title: To do and... to do again 😊
text: Dani our guide was great! He knew how to adapt the tour according to what we had already seen by bus 😊Extremely respectful of security is an extra guide that I recommend 200%. In addition to being very friendly, he speaks French very well. He made us discover great places! And segway no worries if you’ve never done it is easy and very intuitive! I recommend ++ this activity and ideally at the beginning of your stay because your guide will communicate the places and restaurants not to be missed! Thank you for everything Dani!

title: The best experience in Barcelona!
text:
This Segway tour was the best decision we made in Barcelona, we seen all the most popular  and beautiful places in city and had a lot of fun! Guide Max was very lovely and did his best to make us satisfied so in this way he overpass our expectations so I can rate him not 5, but 50* stars as a tour guide, it was perfect. 
Highly recommend this experience, we’ll definitely come back!
